verdict.rationale: Motion documents booking pages, meeting templates, daily meeting limits and unified calendars. Nothing in the evidence shows invitees can reschedule or cancel from a confirmation, that reschedule/cancellation policies are enforced, or that changes propagate across calendars. Daily booking limits and calendar consolidation are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, invitees can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation, with my policies enforced and calendars updated everywhere
